thesis: The episode argues that the United States faces a crisis of public service and institutional decay stemming from the end of the draft in 1973, which symbolically removed the societal duty to serve the country. It further contends that technology can help rebuild trust in institutions and make government cool again by fostering a culture of seriousness and purpose greater than oneself.
